summary: StartOS is a browser-based, graphical operating system designed to simplify the administration of a personal server. It abstracts away command-line complexity to make self-hosting applications feel similar to using a standard desktop computer.
goodFor: Users who want to host their own services and data on dedicated hardware but prefer a graphical web interface over manual command-line configuration.
watchOut: Graphical operating systems for personal servers can sometimes restrict low-level system customisation and introduce abstraction layers that make manual troubleshooting more difficult.
deployNotes: As an operating system image, it typically requires dedicated hardware or a virtualisation environment with persistent storage allocated for system state and hosted services.
